items.title: The effectiveness of instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization on pain and function in patients with musculoskeletal disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis - BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (n=550) found that instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization (IASTM) significantly improved pain (SMD -0.74; 95% CI -1.04 to -0.44) and function (SMD -0.66; 95% CI -0.99 to -0.34) in musculoskeletal disorders in the short term, with moderate effect sizes.
items.curatedReason: IASTM 对肌肉骨骼疾病的疼痛和功能确有短期改善，效果中等。这项纳入了14项RCTs、共550名患者的系统综述和荟萃分析，证实了 IASTM 可作为有效的辅助手段，但它并非解决所有问题的银弹，长期疗效尚无定论。
items.titleZh: 器械辅助软组织松动术对肌肉骨骼疾病患者疼痛和功能的有效性：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 项随机对照试验（n=550）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，器械辅助软组织松动术（IASTM）在短期内显著改善了肌肉骨骼疾病患者的疼痛（SMD -0.74；95% CI -1.04 至 -0.44）和功能（SMD -0.66；95% CI -0.99 至 -0.34），效应量中等。
items.curatedReasonEn: IASTM does offer short-term, moderate improvements in pain and function for musculoskeletal disorders. This systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (n=550) confirms IASTM's role as an effective adjunct, but it's not a panacea, and its long-term efficacy remains undetermined.
items.limitation: 研究的异质性较高，且大多数纳入研究缺乏长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: The study exhibits high heterogeneity, and most included studies lack long-term follow-up data.

items.title: Minimal Important Changes in Accelerometer-Measured Physical Activity and Sedentary Time in Older Patients With Subacute Stroke: A Multicenter Study.
items.summary: A multicenter observational study involving 299 subacute stroke patients estimated the minimal important change (MIC) for accelerometer-measured sedentary behavior, light-intensity physical activity, and moderate-to-vigorous intensity physical activity, ranging from 11.4 to 34.2 minutes, based on improvements in FIM scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心研究首次给出了亚急性卒中老年患者加速计测量的身体活动和久坐时间变化的最小重要改变（MIC），为临床评估康复效果和设定目标提供了量化依据。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中老年患者加速计测量的身体活动和久坐时间变化的最小重要改变：一项多中心研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 299 名亚急性卒中患者的多中心观察性研究估计了加速计测量的久坐行为、轻度身体活动和中高强度身体活动的最小重要改变（MIC），范围为 11.4 至 34.2 分钟，为康复效果评估提供了量化参考。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter study provides the first estimates of minimal important change (MIC) for accelerometer-measured physical activity and sedentary time in older patients with subacute stroke, offering quantitative benchmarks for assessing rehabilitation effectiveness and setting treatment goals.
items.limitation: 研究为观察性设计，依赖自我报告的锚点进行MIC估计。
items.limitationEn: The study's observational design relies on self-reported anchors for MIC estimation.

items.title: Feasibility, content and construct validity of the Patient Specific Functional Scale for chronic stroke survivors.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study with 66 chronic stroke survivors (median 81 years old, 76 months post-onset) confirmed the feasibility, content validity, and construct validity of the Patient Specific Functional Scale (PSFS) using COSMIN standards, with high completion rates and good correlation to other functional measures.
items.curatedReason: 本研究证实了患者特异性功能量表（PSFS）对慢性卒中幸存者的可行性、内容效度和结构效度，为你评估该群体功能受限的个体化目标提供了一个可靠工具。它解决了在慢性卒中语境下 PSFS 应用的痛点。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中幸存者患者特异性功能量表的可行性、内容效度和结构效度。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 66 名慢性卒中幸存者（中位年龄 81 岁，发病后 76 个月）的横断面研究，依据 COSMIN 标准证实了患者特异性功能量表（PSFS）的可行性、内容效度和结构效度，表现出高完成率和与其他功能测量工具的良好相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validates the feasibility, content, and construct validity of the Patient Specific Functional Scale (PSFS) for chronic stroke survivors, providing a reliable tool for assessing individualized functional goals in this population. It addresses a key gap in PSFS application within chronic stroke contexts.
items.limitation: 研究人群年龄偏大，样本量相对有限，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study population was older, and the sample size was relatively limited, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Navigating recovery after flap repair for pressure injury in spinal cord injury/disorder: lived experience and clinician perspectives on complications, resilience, and care models.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the lived experiences of 8 individuals with SCI/D experiencing post-flap complications and 10 multidisciplinary clinicians, revealing themes of shifting realities, motivation through community, and the need for comprehensive, integrated care models in pressure injury recovery.
items.curatedReason: 对于SCI/D患者压疮皮瓣修复术后恢复，我们仍需更全面的整合照护模式。这项研究从8位患者和10位临床医生的经验中发现，除了生理挑战，患者面临的心理和社会现实转变、社群支持的激励作用同样不可忽视。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤/疾病患者压疮皮瓣修复术后恢复的探究：并发症、韧性和护理模式的患者与临床医生视角。
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 8 名经历皮瓣修复并发症的脊髓损伤患者和 10 名多学科临床医生的经验，揭示了压疮恢复中现实转变、社区驱动的动力以及对全面综合护理模式的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: For SCI/D patients recovering from pressure injury flap repair, a more comprehensive, integrated care model is still needed. This study, drawing from the experiences of 8 patients and 10 clinicians, highlights that beyond physiological challenges, the psychological and social shifts patients face, and the motivating role of community support, are equally critical.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study with a small sample size, the generalizability of its findings is limited.

items.title: Co-design of a physical activity maintenance intervention for adults with stroke.
items.summary: A mixed-methods co-design study, involving 38 stakeholders in focus groups and 11 in workshops, developed a physical activity maintenance program for stroke survivors, identifying themes like shifting realities of PA post-stroke and motivation through community.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究通过共同设计方法，为卒中患者在社区康复后维持身体活动提供了干预方案的框架。它强调了将患者、照护者和临床医生纳入设计的重要性，未来有望转化为更符合实际需求的临床工具。
items.titleZh: 卒中成人身体活动维持干预的共同设计。
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法共同设计研究，通过焦点小组（38 名参与者）和工作坊（11 名参与者）为卒中幸存者开发了身体活动维持计划，识别了卒中后身体活动的现实转变和社区驱动的动力等主题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This co-design study provides a framework for physical activity maintenance interventions in stroke survivors post-community rehabilitation, highlighting the importance of involving patients, caregivers, and clinicians. This could lead to more clinically relevant tools in the future.
items.limitation: 本研究为方案设计阶段，尚未进行干预实施与效果评估。
items.limitationEn: This study is in the intervention design phase; implementation and effectiveness evaluation are pending.

items.title: Fatigue in Neurological Rehabilitation: Why Brain Diversity and Population Diversity Matter.
items.summary: A commentary discusses the limitations in neurological fatigue research, noting that 95%-100% of studies rely on questionnaires and peripheral biomarkers, with fewer than 15% using functional neuroimaging, and highlights a lack of population diversity in cohorts.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评批判性地指出了神经康复领域对疲劳研究中“大脑多样性”和“人群多样性”的不足，提醒你关注评估工具的局限性及研究对象地域和族裔的代表性，以更好地理解和干预疲劳。
items.titleZh: 神经康复中的疲劳：为什么大脑多样性和人群多样性至关重要。
items.summaryZh: 一篇述评探讨了神经疲劳研究的局限性，指出 95%-100% 的研究依赖问卷和外周生物标志物，功能神经影像学应用不足 15%，并强调了研究人群多样性的缺失。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary critically highlights deficiencies in "brain diversity" and "population diversity" in neurological rehabilitation fatigue research, urging you to consider the limitations of assessment tools and the representativeness of study populations for better understanding and intervention of fatigue.

items.title: Eight Functional outcomes, two dimensions: a cross-sectional analysis of scale dependence in spatiotemporal gait determinants after subacute stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 244 subacute stroke patients found that eight routinely used gait outcomes primarily represent two dimensions. Spatiotemporal gait parameters were analyzed to determine how determinants differ between these outcomes, suggesting some outcomes reflect similar constructs despite scale differences.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了亚急性卒中患者八种常用功能结局量表（如 BBS、步速、TUG）在评估步态时存在重叠和维度差异，这提示你在选择和解释步态结局指标时，要考虑量表间的关联性，避免重复评估。
items.titleZh: 八种功能结局，两个维度：亚急性卒中后时空步态决定因素的量表依赖性横断面分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 244 名亚急性卒中患者的横断面研究发现，八种常用的步态结局指标主要代表两个维度。分析了时空步态参数以确定不同结局指标的决定因素差异，表明尽管量表不同，部分结局反映了相似的结构。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals overlaps and dimensional differences among eight commonly used functional outcome measures (e.g., BBS, gait velocity, TUG) for gait assessment in subacute stroke. This suggests that you should consider the interrelations between scales when selecting and interpreting gait outcome measures to avoid redundant assessments.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法评估结局量表随时间的动态变化。
items.limitationEn: This study has a cross-sectional design and cannot assess dynamic changes in outcome measures over time.

items.title: Implementing an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in oldest-old nursing home residents: protocol for a pragmatic cluster-randomized controlled trial (SCOPE Study)
items.summary: This article presents the protocol for the SCOPE Study, a pragmatic cluster-randomized controlled trial designed to implement an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in the oldest-old nursing home residents, aiming to provide evidence for effective strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究方案描述了一个针对最老年住院养老院居民的肌少症干预措施，未来有望为这群高危人群的运动处方提供实证依据。目前阶段，它提示你关注肌少症在养老院的干预潜力。
items.titleZh: 针对最老年养老院居民肌少症运动干预的实施方案：一项实用性整群随机对照试验（SCOPE 研究）方案。
items.summaryZh: 本文介绍了 SCOPE 研究方案，这是一项旨在针对最老年养老院居民实施肌少症运动干预的实用性整群随机对照试验，旨在为有效策略提供证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study protocol describes an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in the oldest-old nursing home residents, which could provide evidence for exercise prescriptions in this high-risk population. At this stage, it highlights the potential for sarcopenia interventions in nursing homes.

items.title: REINA: A Recognize-Then-Infer Wearable-to-App AI Framework for Breast Cancer Rehabilitation
items.summary: The REINA AI framework uses wearable IMU data for remote monitoring of motor function in breast cancer rehabilitation, recognizing activities and inferring EMG signals for neuromuscular assessment.
items.curatedReason: REINA这个利用可穿戴设备的AI框架，通过推断神经肌肉活动来远程监测乳腺癌康复患者的运动功能，这听起来很吸引人。但作为临床实践，在广泛应用前，我们必须进一步验证其临床实用性及其在不同患者群体中的有效性。
items.titleZh: REINA：一种用于乳腺癌康复的识别-推断可穿戴设备到应用程序 AI 框架
items.summaryZh: REINA AI 框架利用可穿戴 IMU 数据对乳腺癌康复中的运动功能进行远程监测，识别活动并推断肌电信号以进行神经肌肉评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: REINA, a novel AI framework utilizing wearables, shows promise for remote monitoring of motor function in breast cancer rehabilitation by inferring neuromuscular activity. While this is an interesting technological advancement, its clinical utility and validation in diverse patient populations require further investigation before widespread adoption.
items.limitation: The framework focuses on upper-limb impairments in breast cancer survivors and requires further validation for broader clinical application.
items.limitationEn: The framework focuses on upper-limb impairments in breast cancer survivors and requires further validation for broader clinical application.

items.title: Tailoring Resistance Exercise for Knee Osteoarthritis: An Intervention Systematic Review With Dose-Response Meta-analysis of the Effects of Intensity and Volume.
items.summary: A systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis of RCTs found dose-response relationships between isotonic lower extremity resistance exercise volume and outcomes of pain, function, and strength in people with knee osteoarthritis (OA), and compared different intensities and delivery methods.
items.curatedReason: 膝骨关节炎患者的下肢等张阻力训练，其容量与疼痛、功能和力量改善之间存在明确的剂量-反应关系。你可以根据这篇高质量系统综述的发现，更精准地调整患者的康复方案，包括训练强度和交付方式。
items.titleZh: 针对膝骨关节炎的个体化阻力训练：一项关于强度和容量效应的剂量-反应荟萃分析系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对随机对照试验进行的系统综述和剂量-反应荟萃分析，旨在评估膝骨关节炎患者等张下肢阻力训练的容量与疼痛、功能和力量改善之间的剂量-反应关系，并比较不同强度和实施方式的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: For knee OA patients, isotonic lower extremity resistance exercise volume shows clear dose-response relationships with improvements in pain, function, and strength. Leverage this high-quality systematic review to fine-tune your rehabilitation protocols, including training intensity and delivery methods, for better patient outcomes.
items.limitation: 该综述未明确报告膝骨关节炎阻力训练的最佳长期剂量。
items.limitationEn: The review did not explicitly report on the optimal long-term dosage for resistance training in knee osteoarthritis.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: The Efficacy of Exercise Therapy for Nonspecific Chronic Low Back Pain According to the FITT Principle: A Systematic Review With Meta-analyses.
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analyses evaluated the efficacy of exercise therapy interventions, differing in frequency, intensity, type, and time (FITT), on disability in individuals with nonspecific chronic low back pain (LBP).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述及其荟萃分析，基于 FITT 原则，精细评估了不同运动疗法对非特异性慢性腰痛患者残疾的疗效。这为你调整慢性腰痛患者的运动处方提供了具体的证据指导，让你能更精准地优化干预参数。
items.titleZh: 基于 FITT 原则的运动疗法对非特异性慢性腰痛疗效的系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析评估了根据 FITT（频率、强度、类型、时间）原则调整的运动疗法，对非特异性慢性腰痛患者残疾的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The efficacy of exercise therapy interventions, specifically their FITT parameters (frequency, intensity, type, and time), for disability in nonspecific chronic low back pain patients has been systematically evaluated. This review offers concrete evidence to help you optimize exercise prescription parameters and more precisely manage these patients.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的异质性可能影响了 FITT 各组成部分特定推荐的精确性。
items.limitationEn: The heterogeneity among included studies may impact the precision of specific recommendations for each FITT component.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: APTA Analysis Reveals Greater Long-Term Payment Gains in Medicare Proposal
items.summary: APTA's analysis suggests that the latest Medicare payment proposal could lead to greater long-term payment gains for physical therapists.
items.curatedReason: APTA 的分析显示 Medicare 最新提案可能带来物理治疗师长期支付的增长。这直接影响您未来的报销收入，务必关注后续的具体政策细节和影响。
items.titleZh: APTA 分析揭示 Medicare 提案中长期支付增长潜力
items.summaryZh: APTA 的分析显示，Medicare 最新提案可能为物理治疗师带来更大的长期支付增长。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's analysis indicates that the latest Medicare proposal may lead to long-term payment increases for physical therapists. This directly impacts your future reimbursement revenue, so pay close attention to subsequent policy details and their implications.

items.title: Exploring animal-assisted therapy in stroke rehabilitation: a systematic review of emerging evidence.
items.summary: A systematic review of 12 studies on animal-assisted therapy (AAT) in adult stroke rehabilitation found emerging evidence primarily for psychosocial and emotional benefits, with limited data on motor or cognitive outcomes due to varied study designs and small sample sizes.
items.curatedReason: 动物辅助疗法在卒中康复中的证据仍然有限且异质性高，尚不能支持作为常规干预。目前主要提示在心理社会和情感层面有潜在益处，但在运动或认知功能上尚无定论。继续以研究和辅助手段视角关注，别急于写入常规康复方案。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中动物辅助疗法：系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对12项研究的系统综述显示，动物辅助疗法在成人卒中康复中主要在新兴的心理社会和情感益处方面有初步证据，但由于研究设计多样和样本量小，在运动或认知结局方面数据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for animal-assisted therapy (AAT) in stroke rehabilitation remains limited and highly heterogeneous, not yet supporting its routine integration. Current findings primarily suggest potential benefits in psychosocial and emotional domains, with no definitive conclusions on motor or cognitive functions. Continue to view AAT as an area of research and an adjunctive approach, rather than integrating it into standard rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量少（12项），且设计多样、样本量小，限制了证据的综合性和外推性。
items.limitationEn: The small number of included studies (12), coupled with diverse designs and small sample sizes, limits the generalizability and synthesis of the evidence.

items.title: Association of the time from injury to surgery with postoperative acute cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events in older patients with hip fracture: a retrospective cohort study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study explored the association between the time from injury to surgery and the risk of postoperative acute cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events in older patients with hip fracture.
items.curatedReason: 对于髋部骨折的老年患者，受伤到手术的等待时间，可能影响他们术后发生急性心脑血管事件的风险。作为康复治疗师，这意味着你需要更积极地与多学科团队协作，推动患者在允许的情况下尽快手术，这间接支持了术前优化干预的必要性。
items.titleZh: 髋部骨折老年患者受伤至手术时间与术后急性心血管或脑血管事件的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究探讨了髋部骨折老年患者从受伤到手术的时间与术后急性心血管或脑血管事件风险之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older patients with hip fracture, the time from injury to surgery might influence their risk of postoperative acute cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events. As therapists, this implies a need for more proactive collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advocate for prompt surgery when medically appropriate, indirectly supporting the necessity of pre-operative optimization.
items.limitation: 回顾性队列研究可能存在混杂因素和信息偏差，且因果关系难以确定。
items.limitationEn: Retrospective cohort studies may be subject to confounding factors and information bias, and causal relationships are difficult to establish.

items.title: Effects of Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training and physical therapy on gait quality in children with cerebral palsy: A severity-stratified analysis.
items.summary: A retrospective observational study found that Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training combined with physical therapy improved spatiotemporal gait parameters and overall gait quality in 52 children with cerebral palsy across different GMFCS levels.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究表明，Lokomat 机器人步态训练结合物理治疗能改善脑瘫儿童的步态质量，尤其是对于不同运动障碍严重程度的患儿。这为临床实践中机器人辅助疗法的使用提供了进一步证据。
items.titleZh: Lokomat 机器人辅助步态训练和物理治疗对脑瘫儿童步态质量的影响：一项按严重程度分层的分析
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性观察研究发现，52 名脑瘫儿童在接受 Lokomat 机器人辅助步态训练和物理治疗后，其步态时空参数和整体步态质量均有所改善，且治疗效果在不同运动障碍严重程度的患儿中有所体现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study indicates that Lokomat-based robotic gait training combined with physical therapy can improve gait quality in children with cerebral palsy, including those with varying motor impairment severities. This provides further evidence for the use of robotic-assisted therapy in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，存在固有的局限性，如数据缺失和无法控制的混杂因素，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective observational study, it has inherent limitations such as missing data and uncontrolled confounding factors, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Living with stroke-related visual impairment: a qualitative exploration of lived experience, self-management, and support needs.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the lived experiences of 16 community-dwelling adults in Scotland with stroke-related visual impairment (SRVI), identifying daily impact, self-management strategies, and unmet support needs.
items.curatedReason: 对于卒中后视力障碍（SRVI）患者，他们的真实生活挑战、自我管理策略和未满足的需求是临床中常被忽视的。这项针对16名苏格兰社区居民的定性研究，揭示了SRVI对功能、心理和社交的全面影响，提示我们在制定康复计划时，需要更细致地关注这些方面。
items.titleZh: 卒中相关视力障碍患者的生活：一项对生活经验、自我管理和支持需求的定性探索
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究对苏格兰 16 名社区居住的卒中相关视力障碍（SRVI）患者进行了访谈，以了解其日常生活影响、自我管理策略及未满足的支持需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with stroke-related visual impairment (SRVI), their real-life challenges, self-management strategies, and unmet needs are often overlooked in clinical practice. This qualitative study of 16 community-dwelling adults in Scotland reveals the comprehensive functional, psychological, and social impacts of SRVI, suggesting we need to pay closer attention to these aspects when developing rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性观察，样本量较小（16 例），且受访者来自苏格兰一个区域，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative observational study has a small sample size (16 participants) and was conducted in a specific region of Scotland, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Sensorimotor effects of heatwrap and exercise in acute low back pain: results of a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=99) found that heatwrap combined with exercise was more effective than sham heatwrap in improving pain sensitivity, lumbar muscle activity, current pain intensity, and trunk flexion range of motion in acute low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT验证了热敷结合运动对急性腰痛在减轻疼痛敏感性、改善腰部肌肉活动和躯干屈曲范围方面的益处。在处理急性腰痛时，你应将热敷与运动结合作为一线干预。
items.titleZh: 热敷结合运动对急性腰痛感觉运动效应的随机对照试验结果
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，对于急性腰痛患者，热敷结合运动在改善疼痛敏感性、腰部肌肉活动、疼痛强度和躯干屈曲范围方面优于单独热敷或安慰剂。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms the benefits of heatwrap combined with exercise for acute low back pain in reducing pain sensitivity, improving lumbar muscle activity, and increasing trunk flexion range of motion. For acute low back pain, you should incorporate combined heatwrap and exercise as a first-line intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心RCT，可能限制了结果的普遍性，且未报告长期随访结果。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center RCT, which may limit the generalizability of the findings, and long-term follow-up results were not reported.

items.title: Home-based digital exercise versus hospital physiotherapy for plantar fasciitis: a propensity-score-matched retrospective cohort study with dual-perspective cost-utility evaluation.
items.summary: A propensity-score-matched retrospective cohort study in China found that a 12-week home-based digital exercise program was non-inferior to hospital-supervised physiotherapy for plantar fasciitis regarding first-step morning pain (adjusted mean difference -0.63 points, 95% CI -0.92 to -0.35; p < 0.001) and showed cost-utility advantages from both payer and societal perspectives.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，对于足底筋膜炎，居家数字运动方案在临床疗效和成本效益上均不劣于医院物理治疗。这支持了远程康复在中国的应用潜力，为诊所和医院考虑如何拓展服务模式提供了重要依据。
items.titleZh: 居家数字运动与医院物理治疗治疗足底筋膜炎的对比：一项匹配回顾性队列研究及成本效益评估
items.summaryZh: 一项在中国进行的回顾性队列研究显示，为期12周的居家数字运动方案在治疗足底筋膜炎的临床疗效上不劣于医院物理治疗，且在成本效益方面更具优势。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates that home-based digital exercise is non-inferior to hospital physiotherapy for plantar fasciitis in both clinical effectiveness and cost-effectiveness. This supports the potential of telerehabilitation in China, offering crucial evidence for clinics and hospitals to expand their service models.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心回顾性队列研究，且匹配算法无法完全消除所有混杂因素，结果可能存在选择偏倚。研究在中国三级医院进行，结果对其他国家或医疗环境的适用性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective cohort study, and propensity-score matching cannot eliminate all confounders, potentially introducing selection bias. Conducted in Chinese tertiary hospitals, the generalizability of results to other countries or healthcare settings needs further validation.

items.title: Feasibility study of gait analysis using a new Wearable Force Plate
items.summary: A feasibility study evaluated ShokacShoes, a novel sensorized shoe integrating three triaxial force sensors, demonstrating its usability for measuring three-dimensional ground reaction forces in gait analysis.
items.curatedReason: 这款新型可穿戴式力板鞋在步态分析中展现出可行性，解决了传统力板在真实环境中应用的局限。它有望成为你临床评估中新的移动工具，但需等待更多验证性研究。
items.titleZh: 新型可穿戴式力板进行步态分析的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项可行性研究评估了ShokacShoes，这是一种集成三个三轴力传感器的新型可穿戴式鞋，并证明了其在步态分析中测量三维地面反作用力的可用性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This novel wearable force plate shoe demonstrates feasibility for gait analysis, addressing the limitations of traditional force plates in real-world settings. It holds promise as a new mobile tool for your clinical assessments, but requires further validation studies.
items.limitation: 本研究主要关注新设备的可用性评估，样本量较小，且未与其他金标准设备进行直接的临床有效性对比，缺乏在病理人群中的大规模验证数据。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily focused on evaluating the usability of the new device with a small sample size, lacked direct clinical effectiveness comparisons with gold standard devices, and did not include large-scale validation data in pathological populations.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Revised Supervised practice framework supports modern, flexible supervision
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) has released a revised supervised practice framework, aiming to support modern and flexible supervision across health professions.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚物理治疗师注意：AHPRA 更新了监督执业框架，引入了更灵活、现代的监督模式。如果你在澳大利亚执业或考虑在澳执业，这直接影响你的学习、进修和执业路径。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局——修订后的监督执业框架支持现代化、灵活的监督模式
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局 (AHPRA) 发布了修订后的监督执业框架，旨在支持各卫生专业的现代化、灵活监督模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: Attention Australian physical therapists: AHPRA has updated its supervised practice framework, introducing a more flexible and modern supervision model. If you practice or are considering practicing in Australia, this directly impacts your learning, professional development, and practice pathways.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Call for applications: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Practice Accreditation Committee
items.summary: AHPRA has issued a call for applications for the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Practice Accreditation Committee, seeking registered practitioners with experience in education or Indigenous health.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚物理治疗师可留意这条：AHPRA 正在招募原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康执业认证委员会成员。如果你有教育或原住民健康方面的经验，可以考虑申请。这对于提升 PT 行业多元化和文化能力至关重要。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局——原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康执业认证委员会征集申请
items.summaryZh: AHPRA 正在征集原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康执业认证委员会的申请，寻求具有教育或原住民健康经验的注册执业者。
items.curatedReasonEn: Australian physical therapists might note this: AHPRA is recruiting members for the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Practice Accreditation Committee. If you have experience in education or Indigenous health, consider applying. This is crucial for enhancing diversity and cultural competence within the PT profession.

items.title: A single-session randomised crossover fNIRS study comparing three upper-limb mirror therapy task paradigms in healthy adults: a study protocol
items.summary: A single-session randomized crossover fNIRS study protocol comparing three upper-limb mirror therapy task paradigms and associated subjective experiences in healthy adults.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究方案详细描述了使用功能性近红外光谱技术 (fNIRS) 比较三种上肢镜像疗法任务范式的机制研究。虽然只是协议，但它预示了未来神经康复领域对镜像疗法生理机制理解的深化，这对于理解治疗的有效性边界至关重要。
items.titleZh: 一项单次随机交叉 fNIRS 研究方案，比较健康成人三种上肢镜像疗法任务范式
items.summaryZh: 一项单次随机交叉功能性近红外光谱 (fNIRS) 研究方案，旨在比较健康成人三种上肢镜像疗法任务范式及其相关主观体验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study protocol details a mechanistic study using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) to compare three upper-limb mirror therapy task paradigms. Although it's only a protocol, it signals a deepening understanding of the physiological mechanisms of mirror therapy in neurorehabilitation, which is crucial for comprehending the boundaries of treatment effectiveness.
items.limitation: 此为研究方案，尚未有实际结果数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and no actual results data are available yet.

items.title: Patient-reported knee osteoarthritis problems and rehabilitation goals: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study analyzing data from 387 participants with chronic knee osteoarthritis pain identified activity limitations and pain as the worst aspects of their condition, with rehabilitation goals centered on improving these functional issues.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调，膝关节骨关节炎患者最关注的是活动受限和疼痛，他们的康复目标也紧密围绕这些核心功能障碍。这提醒您在制定治疗计划时，要更聚焦患者报告的症状，确保干预措施能解决他们的实际痛点。
items.titleZh: 膝关节骨关节炎患者报告的问题和康复目标：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究分析了 387 名慢性膝关节骨关节炎疼痛患者的数据，发现活动受限和疼痛是他们最关注的问题，康复目标主要集中在改善这些功能障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights that knee OA patients prioritize activity limitations and pain, with rehabilitation goals closely aligned with these core functional impairments. This reminds you to focus on patient-reported symptoms when planning treatment, ensuring interventions address their practical concerns.
items.limitation: 本研究数据来源于一项随机对照试验的基线调查，可能未能充分捕捉到患者在康复过程中的动态目标变化。
items.limitationEn: The data for this study were drawn from baseline surveys of a randomized controlled trial, which may not fully capture dynamic changes in patient goals during the rehabilitation process.

items.title: Feasibility and Safety Evaluation of Hybrid Assistive Limb-Based Neurorehabilitation for Patients with Central Motor Dysfunction: A Single-Center Study.
items.summary: A single-center, non-randomized study with 229 patients with central motor dysfunction evaluated the feasibility and safety of Hybrid Assistive Limb (HAL)-assisted neurorehabilitation across inpatient and outpatient settings.
items.curatedReason: Hybrid Assistive Limb (HAL) 机器人辅助神经康复在 229 名中枢性运动功能障碍患者中显示出良好的可行性和安全性。尽管是单中心非随机研究，但其大规模真实世界数据提示了这类设备在临床实践中的应用潜力。
items.titleZh: Hybrid Assistive Limb 辅助神经康复在中枢性运动功能障碍患者中的可行性与安全性评估：一项单中心研究
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心、非随机研究评估了 229 名中枢性运动功能障碍患者在住院和门诊环境下，使用 Hybrid Assistive Limb (HAL) 辅助神经康复的可行性和安全性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Hybrid Assistive Limb (HAL) robot-assisted neurorehabilitation demonstrated good feasibility and safety in 229 patients with central motor dysfunction. Despite being a single-center, non-randomized study, its large real-world dataset suggests the potential for such devices in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心非随机、单臂研究，缺乏对照组，无法评估 HAL 辅助康复的实际疗效，且存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center, non-randomized, single-arm study lacking a control group, thus unable to evaluate the actual efficacy of HAL-assisted rehabilitation, and subject to selection bias.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation and Individualized Physical Therapy on Pain and Function in Individuals With Chronic Knee Pain: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A preliminary triple-blinded, randomized, and sham-controlled pilot study found that 5 sessions of active tDCS followed by individualized PT improved pain and function in individuals with chronic knee pain.
items.curatedReason: 试点研究提示，经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）联合个体化物理治疗可能有助于改善慢性膝关节疼痛患者的疼痛和功能，但当前证据样本量小，外推性有限。
items.titleZh: 经颅直流电刺激联合个体化物理治疗对慢性膝关节疼痛患者疼痛和功能的影响：一项试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项初步的三盲、随机、假对照试点研究发现，5次主动经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）联合个体化物理治疗改善了慢性膝关节疼痛患者的疼痛和功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) combined with individualized physical therapy may improve pain and function in individuals with chronic knee pain. However, the current evidence is based on a small sample size with limited generalizability.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小，为初步试点结果，需要更大规模的RCT验证。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, presenting preliminary pilot results that require validation through larger RCTs.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Ideal Versus Actual School-Based Physiotherapy Practice in Israel: A National Survey.
items.summary: A national survey of 202 and 152 physiotherapists in Israel compared actual versus ideal school-based physiotherapy practice across 30 items related to evaluation, IEP development, service delivery, team functioning, and administrative support.
items.curatedReason: 以色列全国调查揭示了校本物理治疗师实际执业与理想执业之间存在的显著差距，并指明了阻碍理想实践实施的障碍。这一发现对评估全球范围内校本物理治疗服务的质量和发展方向具有参考意义，有助于优化资源配置和政策制定。
items.titleZh: 以色列校本物理治疗的理想与实际实践：一项全国性调查
items.summaryZh: 一项对以色列202名和152名物理治疗师进行的全国性调查，比较了校本物理治疗在评估、个体化教育计划制定、服务提供、团队协作和行政支持等30个项目上的实际与理想实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: A national survey in Israel reveals significant gaps between actual and ideal school-based physiotherapy practice, identifying barriers to implementing preferred practices. This finding is relevant for assessing the quality and direction of school-based physiotherapy services globally, aiding in optimizing resource allocation and policy development.
items.limitation: 数据来源于自我报告的在线问卷，可能存在回忆偏倚和主观性。
items.limitationEn: The data were collected via self-reported online surveys, which may introduce recall bias and subjectivity.

items.title: Responsiveness of the Timed 'Up and Go' test in people with Parkinson's disease.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 196 people with Parkinson's disease found that the Timed 'Up and Go' test showed significant responsiveness (p < 0.001) in detecting changes in functional mobility after a median 20-day inpatient rehabilitation stay.
items.curatedReason: 回顾性队列研究证实 Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) 测试在帕金森病患者中具有良好的响应性，能够有效检测多学科住院康复后的功能流动性改善。这强化了 TUG 在帕金森患者康复效果评估中的实用性。
items.titleZh: Timed 'Up and Go' 测试在帕金森病患者中的响应性
items.summaryZh: 一项对196名帕金森病患者进行的回顾性队列研究发现，Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) 测试在为期20天的住院康复后，在检测功能流动性变化方面表现出显著响应性（p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective cohort study confirms the good responsiveness of the Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) test in people with Parkinson's disease, effectively detecting improvements in functional mobility after multidisciplinary inpatient rehabilitation. This strengthens the practicality of TUG in assessing rehabilitation outcomes for Parkinson's patients.
items.limitation: 该研究为回顾性设计，存在潜在的选择偏倚和混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective design of this study introduces potential selection bias and confounding factors.

items.title: Factors associated with post-stroke pain and pain perception-a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified 67 studies with 31,071 participants to summarize factors affecting pain and pain perception in stroke survivors, aiming to systematically characterize these influences.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述系统性地识别并总结了卒中后疼痛及其感知的影响因素，为理解卒中患者复杂疼痛机制及其康复管理提供了全面的视角。
items.titleZh: 卒中后疼痛及疼痛感知相关因素：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别了67项研究共31,071名参与者，旨在总结影响卒中幸存者疼痛和疼痛感知的因素，并系统性地描述这些影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review systematically identifies and summarizes factors affecting post-stroke pain and its perception, offering a comprehensive perspective for understanding complex pain mechanisms and rehabilitation management in stroke patients.
items.limitation: 范围综述的性质决定了其不能进行定量分析或对证据质量进行严格分级。
items.limitationEn: Due to its nature, a scoping review cannot conduct quantitative analysis or rigorously grade the quality of evidence.

items.title: Digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy reduces pain in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain: a multicentre randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: An 8-week smartphone-based multidisciplinary digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy significantly reduced usual knee pain in 216 participants with chronic patellofemoral pain compared to education and exercise instruction.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性髌股疼痛，数字疗法结合运动与 CBT 表现出显著优于单纯教育的短期疗效。在临床实践中，可以考虑将这类数字化方案作为传统治疗的有效补充，以提升患者依从性和疗效。
items.titleZh: 数字疗法结合运动与认知行为疗法可减轻慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的多中心随机对照试验显示，针对 216 名慢性髌股疼痛患者，结合运动与认知行为疗法的智能手机数字疗法在减轻膝关节疼痛方面显著优于单纯的教育和运动指导。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic patellofemoral pain, digital therapeutics combining exercise and CBT show significantly better short-term efficacy than education alone. Consider these digital solutions as an effective complement to traditional therapy to improve patient adherence and outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了 8 周的短期效果，长期疗效和依从性仍需更多证据。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed short-term effects over 8 weeks; long-term efficacy and adherence require further evidence.

items.title: Gait Speed Changes in Stroke Rehabilitation Motor Lower Extremity Randomized Controlled Trials by Intervention and Time Post-Stroke: A Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A meta-analysis of RCTs evaluated gait speed changes in motor lower extremity stroke rehabilitation across various interventions, compared to conventional care or sham controls, at different time points post-stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析量化了卒中后下肢运动康复干预对步速的改善效果。它为不同时间点和不同干预措施下的步速变化提供了坚实的证据基础，是指导临床路径和设定康复目标的重要参考。
items.titleZh: 不同干预措施和卒中后时间点下，卒中康复下肢运动随机对照试验中步速变化：一项荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项荟萃分析根据 PRISMA 指南，系统性地评估了截至 2024 年发表的英文 RCT，以考察卒中后下肢运动康复干预在不同时间点对步速的影响，并与常规护理或安慰剂对照进行比较。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis quantifies the impact of lower extremity motor rehabilitation interventions on gait speed post-stroke. It provides a solid evidence base for gait speed changes across various interventions and time points, serving as a crucial reference for guiding clinical pathways and setting rehabilitation goals.
items.limitation: 原始研究可能存在的异质性以及出版偏倚可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: Potential heterogeneity and publication bias in the original studies may affect the generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: What Matters Most: A Multi-Stakeholder Study of Outcome Domains in Lower-Limb Prosthesis Use
items.summary: This mixed-methods study aimed to develop a stakeholder-informed framework of outcome domains relevant to everyday lower-limb prosthesis use, integrating findings from existing PROMs, interviews with 12 prosthesis users, 4 clinicians, and 2 industrial partners.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究通过多方利益相关者视角，识别了下肢假肢使用中最重要的结局领域。它提醒你在评估假肢使用效果时，除了物理功能，还需整合心理社会和装置相关因素，以提供更全面的康复方案。
items.titleZh: 最重要的是什么：一项下肢假肢使用结局域的多方利益相关者研究
items.summaryZh: 这项混合方法研究旨在开发一个由利益相关者参与制定的框架，涵盖与下肢假肢日常使用相关的关键结局领域，整合了现有患者报告结局测量（PROM）、12 名假肢使用者、4 名临床医生和 2 名行业合作伙伴的访谈结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multi-stakeholder study identifies the most important outcome domains in lower-limb prosthesis use. It reminds you to integrate psychosocial and device-related factors, in addition to physical function, when evaluating prosthesis outcomes, to provide more comprehensive rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 研究主要依赖定性分析和利益相关者评级，其结果在不同文化背景和医疗系统中的普适性有待进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study primarily relies on qualitative analysis and stakeholder ratings, and the generalizability of its findings across different cultural backgrounds and healthcare systems needs further validation.

items.title: Adapted cardiac rehabilitation for individuals after stroke and transient ischaemic attack: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 19 studies (1951 participants) found that adapted cardiac rehabilitation-based interventions for individuals after stroke or TIA are safe, feasible, and acceptable, primarily for those with minimal disability.
items.curatedReason: 卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）后的心血管风险很高，该综述提示基于心脏康复的干预对这部分人群是安全、可行且可接受的。考虑将心肺康复的原则整合到神经康复方案中，这能更好地管理患者的整体健康。
items.titleZh: 卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作患者的适应性心脏康复：一项范围审查。
items.summaryZh: 一项对19项研究（1951名参与者）进行的范围审查发现，针对卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）患者的适应性心脏康复干预是安全、可行和可接受的，主要适用于残疾程度较轻的患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: Cardiovascular risk is high after stroke and transient ischemic attack (TIA). This scoping review suggests that cardiac rehabilitation-based interventions are safe, feasible, and acceptable for this population. Consider integrating cardiopulmonary rehabilitation principles into neurorehabilitation protocols to better manage patients' overall health.
items.limitation: 大多数纳入研究的参与者为轻度或无卒中相关残疾，结果对外推至重度卒中患者的适用性有限。
items.limitationEn: Most included studies involved participants with minimal or no stroke-associated disability, limiting generalizability to those with severe stroke.

items.title: Patients' Mental Barriers in Rehabilitation after ACL Reconstruction: A Qualitative Interview Study.
items.summary: A qualitative interview study with nine patients explored the psychological barriers during rehabilitation after ACL reconstruction (ACLR) and the role of physical therapists in enhancing psychological readiness for return to sport.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后患者的康复不仅是身体挑战，心理障碍也同等重要。你需要关注患者的心理准备状态，在康复过程中积极与其互动，帮助他们识别并克服心理障碍，这对重返运动至关重要。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后康复患者的心理障碍：一项定性访谈研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项对9名患者进行的定性访谈研究探讨了 ACL 重建术后康复期间的心理障碍，以及物理治疗师在增强患者重返运动心理准备方面的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Rehabilitation after ACL reconstruction is not only a physical challenge but also a psychological one. You need to focus on patients' psychological readiness, actively interact with them during rehabilitation, and help them identify and overcome mental barriers, which is crucial for return to sport.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小，结果的普遍性有限，主要反映了特定文化背景下的患者体验。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size, limiting generalizability and primarily reflecting patient experiences within specific cultural contexts.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Return to Golf Rehabilitation Progression after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Using an Evidence-Based Foundation.
items.summary: This clinical commentary synthesizes golf-biomechanics and ACLR-rehabilitation evidence to present an evidence-informed, criteria-based return-to-golf progression from putting through unrestricted course play.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床述评首次系统地为 ACLR 术后高尔夫球手提供了基于证据的重返运动方案。它填补了现有通用指南的空白，为您管理这类特定运动员提供了从推杆到无限制下场的详细分期指导。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后基于证据的重返高尔夫康复进展
items.summaryZh: 本临床述评综合了高尔夫生物力学和前交叉韧带重建术后康复证据，提出了一项基于证据、以标准为导向的重返高尔夫康复方案，涵盖从推杆到无限制下场的全过程。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical commentary is the first to systematically provide an evidence-based return-to-sport protocol for golfers after ACLR. It fills a gap in existing general guidelines, offering you detailed, staged guidance from putting to unrestricted course play for managing this specific athlete population.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Adductor-Related Athletic Groin Pain: A Clinical Commentary.
items.summary: This clinical commentary synthesizes current evidence regarding anatomy, risk factors, pathomechanics, imaging, prevention, rehabilitation, and return-to-sport decision-making for adductor-related athletic groin pain (ARAGP).
items.curatedReason: 处理内收肌相关运动性腹股沟疼痛 (ARAGP) 复杂且棘手，这份综述系统地梳理了从解剖、风险因素到康复和重返运动决策的最新证据。你可以此为框架，优化你的评估和干预策略。
items.titleZh: 内收肌相关运动性腹股沟疼痛：一项临床述评
items.summaryZh: 本临床述评综合了内收肌相关运动性腹股沟疼痛（ARAGP）在解剖、风险因素、病理生物力学、影像学考量、预防策略、康复原则和重返运动决策方面的现有证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adductor-related athletic groin pain (ARAGP) is complex to manage. This review systematically synthesizes the latest evidence from anatomy and risk factors to rehabilitation and return-to-sport decisions. Use it as a framework to refine your assessment and intervention strategies.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Calcific Patellar Tendinopathy. A Case Report Integrating Diagnostic Ultrasound Throughout a Multi-Modal Treatment Approach.
items.summary: A case report describes the successful integration of diagnostic ultrasound and dry needling within a multi-modal treatment approach for a 46-year-old active female with calcific patellar tendinopathy.
items.curatedReason: 本病例报告展示了诊断性超声和干针如何结合多模式治疗，成功管理伴钙化性髌腱病的复杂病例，为您在类似情况下提供治疗思路。
items.titleZh: 钙化性髌腱病：诊断性超声与多模式治疗方法整合的病例报告
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一名 46 岁活动女性的钙化性髌腱病，通过整合诊断性超声和干针等多种治疗手段，成功实现了评估和管理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report demonstrates how diagnostic ultrasound and dry needling can be integrated into a multi-modal approach to successfully manage complex cases of calcific patellar tendinopathy, offering you a treatment framework for similar scenarios.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Utilization of the Functional Lower Extremity Evaluation (FLEE) in Return-to-Sport Rehabilitation Protocol Following Hip Arthroscopy in Collegiate Athletes: A Case Series.
items.summary: A case series investigated the utility of the Functional Lower Extremity Evaluation (FLEE) in guiding return-to-sport rehabilitation protocols for collegiate athletes after hip arthroscopy.
items.curatedReason: FLEE 作为下肢功能评估工具，其在髋关节镜术后大学生运动员重返运动方案中的应用是重要实践探索。您可以参考其组件来更精细地评估患者的肢体对称性和功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 髋关节镜术后大学生运动员重返运动康复方案中功能性下肢评估（FLEE）的应用：病例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 本病例系列研究探讨了功能性下肢评估（FLEE）在指导髋关节镜术后大学生运动员重返运动康复方案中的效用，并评估了利用 FLEE 组件进行下肢对称性评估的可行性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The application of FLEE as a lower extremity functional assessment tool in return-to-sport protocols for collegiate athletes post-hip arthroscopy is an important practical exploration. You can refer to its components for more refined assessment of limb symmetry and functional recovery in your patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例系列，证据等级较低，无法得出因果结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a case series, offering a lower level of evidence and preventing causal conclusions.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Paired comparison of extrinsic feedback effects on motor learning and functional recovery after stroke: a secondary analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of randomized controlled trials (updated through November 2025) compared the effects of extrinsic feedback on motor learning versus functional recovery after stroke, calculating standardized mean differences using random-effects meta-analysis and accounting for within-study dependence.
items.curatedReason: 这项更新的荟萃分析提示，卒中后的外部反馈对运动学习和功能恢复效果不一。临床应用时，要根据具体的康复目标来调整反馈策略，而不是一概而论。
items.titleZh: 卒中后外部反馈对运动学习与功能恢复效果的配对比较：随机对照试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项基于随机对照试验的二次分析（更新至2025年11月）比较了卒中后外部反馈对运动学习与功能恢复的不同效果，使用随机效应荟萃分析计算标准化均差并考虑了研究内依赖性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated meta-analysis suggests that extrinsic feedback after stroke has varied effects on motor learning and functional recovery. In clinical practice, adjust feedback strategies according to specific rehabilitation goals, rather than applying them uniformly.
items.limitation: 研究是基于已有随机对照试验的二次分析，可能受限于原始研究的设计和数据报告质量，且不同效应之间的相关性假设可能影响结果。
items.limitationEn: The study is a secondary analysis of existing randomized controlled trials, potentially limited by the design and data reporting quality of the original studies, and assumed correlations between different effects might influence the results.

items.title: Effects of ketogenic diet on obesity indices, lipid profile, and glycemic control parameters in athletes: a GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials evaluated the effects of ketogenic diet on obesity indices, lipid profile, and glycemic control parameters in athletes, addressing inconsistencies in previous findings.
items.curatedReason: 对于运动员，生酮饮食对体重指标、血脂和血糖控制参数的效果仍需谨慎看待。在推荐前，务必权衡其潜在益处与代谢风险。
items.titleZh: 生酮饮食对运动员肥胖指标、血脂和血糖控制参数的影响：一项GRADE评估的随机对照试验系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项经过GRADE评估的随机对照试验系统综述和荟萃分析，评估了生酮饮食对运动员肥胖指标、血脂和血糖控制参数的影响，旨在解决此前研究结果的不一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For athletes, the effects of ketogenic diet on obesity indices, lipid profile, and glycemic control parameters still require careful consideration. Before recommendation, it is essential to weigh its potential benefits against metabolic risks.
items.limitation: 系统综述可能存在纳入研究异质性高、样本量相对较小、随访时间不一等局限性，影响结论的普适性。
items.limitationEn: Systematic reviews may have limitations such as high heterogeneity among included studies, relatively small sample sizes, and varying follow-up durations, which can affect the generalizability of the conclusions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Navigating expectation-evidence tensions in musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
items.summary: This professional practice article discusses the contextual and ethical foundations of patient expectations in musculoskeletal physiotherapy and introduces the Contextually Informed Expectation Alignment framework to address the tension between patient expectations and evidence-informed care.
items.curatedReason: 这篇专业实践文章提出了一个框架，帮助您在骨科物理治疗中平衡患者期望与循证实践。它承认患者期望对治疗效果的影响，并提供了一个结构化方法来处理由此产生的伦理和临床挑战，促进以人为本的护理，同时维护专业完整性。
items.titleZh: 应对肌肉骨骼物理治疗中期望与证据之间的张力
items.summaryZh: 这篇专业实践文章讨论了肌肉骨骼物理治疗中患者期望的背景和伦理基础，并引入了“情境知情期望对齐框架”，以解决患者期望与循证护理之间的张力。
items.curatedReasonEn: You now have a “Contextually Informed Expectation Alignment” framework to navigate the tension between patient expectations and evidence-informed practice. Patient expectations demonstrably impact outcomes; your role is to manage these effectively while upholding professional ethics and evidence-based principles, and this article offers a method to do so.

items.title: Reduced trailing limb angle is associated with near-falls during walking in stroke survivors.
items.summary: A cross-sectional observational study of 157 subacute stroke survivors found that a reduced trailing limb angle (TLA) during normal walking was associated with near-falls, highlighting a potential gait characteristic for fall risk assessment.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，卒中幸存者在步行时，较小的后肢摆动角（TLA）可能与近乎跌倒事件相关。这为您在进行步态评估和跌倒风险筛查时，提供了一个新的潜在生物力学指标。
items.titleZh: 卒中幸存者步行时后肢摆动角减小与近乎跌倒相关
items.summaryZh: 一项对 157 名亚急性卒中幸存者的横断面观察研究发现，正常步行时后肢摆动角（TLA）减小与近乎跌倒相关，提示其可能是跌倒风险评估的潜在步态特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that a reduced trailing limb angle (TLA) during walking may be associated with near-fall events in stroke survivors. This offers a new potential biomechanical indicator for your gait assessment and fall risk screening in this population.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察性设计，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study used a cross-sectional observational design, which cannot establish causality.
